story_fr: Nasdaq augmente son dividende trimestriel de 0,27 $ a 0,31 $ par action en avril 2026, soit une hausse de 14,8 % refletant la solidite du cash-flow.
story_en: Nasdaq raises its quarterly dividend from $0.27 to $0.31 per share in April 2026, a 14.8% increase reflecting strong cash generation.
quote: Nasdaq Announces Increase in Quarterly Dividend to $0.31 Per Share

story_fr: Nasdaq verse un dividende trimestriel sans interruption depuis au moins 2021, temoignant d'une politique de retour aux actionnaires stable et previsible.
story_en: Nasdaq has paid a quarterly dividend without interruption since at least 2021, demonstrating a stable and predictable shareholder return policy.
quote: Nasdaq Announces Quarterly Dividend of $0.27 Per Share

story_fr: En 2022, Nasdaq effectue un split 3-pour-1 sous forme de dividende en actions, avec prise d'effet le 29 aout 2022, visant a ameliorer l'accessibilite du titre.
story_en: In 2022, Nasdaq executes a 3-for-1 stock split in the form of a stock dividend effective August 29, 2022, aimed at improving share accessibility.
quote: 3-for-1 stock split in the form of a stock dividend

story_fr: Nasdaq reorganise ses activites en trois divisions strategiques : Market Platforms, Capital Access Platforms et Anti-Financial Crime, renforçant sa lisibilite sectorielle.
story_en: Nasdaq reorganizes into three strategic divisions: Market Platforms, Capital Access Platforms, and Anti-Financial Crime, improving segment clarity for investors.
quote: Market Platforms, Capital Access Platforms, Anti-Financial Crime
